entries.claim: Historical English basis of the antiphon and the psalm verse (the Douay Isa 9:2, 6 and Ps 92:1 through this missal), revised against the Latin in contemporary language: will shine today, for, He will be called, of whose kingdom (regni) there will be no end, has reigned; the Gloria Patri is the closed formula with Holy Spirit, and the repeated antiphon takes the same revised wording.
